notes.title: Big update! New game graphics were added!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] The heroines' faces now are more anime-like. 
[*] We fixed the anatomy of the sprites. 
[*] Few CG were split into layers and now they have cool appearing animation. 
[*] Characters gallery added. 
[*] The "Planets" minigame is now fixed and should work flawlessly. 
[*] "Arrows" minigame was improved with new game mechanics. 
[*] "Arrows" minigame now features extra character to beat. 
[*] New song was composed especially for the renewal trailer. 
[*] You can now play the game on MacOS. 
[*] We put our heart and soul into our novel to make it more perfect.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31994274/bd3ff291cb5af9dca509ad6f4734c58b39a6602c.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy New Year from 7DOTS
notes.content:
[b]Hey, 7DOTS fans! Did you know that we have a twitter account and we often host giveaways? C:  (along with posting the news about our upcoming games) Right now we're hosting Totem City steam key giveaway. It means you can play the long-awaited continuation of "Stop the Earth, I'm getting off" saga before its actual release! (if you're lucky enough, that is ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) )

Giveaway link: https://twitter.com/7DOTSVN/status/1211650705322319873[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/8aa5873688f9eb2e54c124c47b016aef950842ba.png[/img]

[b]Let us show you a few projects we're currently working on: [/b]

[b][h1]THE BADACES[/h1][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/fbd58d599912408ea8b4e58641a957f94e503b98.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]NEURONAUT[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/6193fc0b353784daaa30c104135085ed77a5364e.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/1a1d01524fcf386c331ec27fe1f69f69c5e3a79a.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/8b2589a12a45adcbaa3d3b8766f85ab14b0e6638.png[/img]

[b]Neuronaut is almost done (we're currently proofreading it), so expect it to be released in early 2020.

We also have plans on releasing an expanded version of Crystal City next year. It was decided to add extra routes and new content, so it wouldn't be a kinetic novel anymore. ;) So stay tuned.[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
[list]
[*] At the player's request, we removed achievements for completing mini-games. 
[*] We also fixed some of the common bugs and added "18+ option" right in the settings menu. (You can also turn it on by pushing F2 button).
[*] But due to specifics of the RenPy engine old saves may not work again. In that case, you can push "x" button in the left bottom corner of the save menu and it will delete all your saves and achievements for you to start over.
[*] "C" button will copy the contents of the dialog box to a clipboard. This will help the players that want to report an error found in the text or quote it.
[*] If you set messages to "Skip all" setting, you can easily skip the text to the needed moment by simply pushing TAB.
[/list]

[h1]Happy playing![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31994274/62bc4437fcec15a0a2fac6511a2781829afabf0c.jpg[/img]
